top_signals.title: Bitcoin slides below $70K amid thin liquidity, ETF outflows
top_signals.summary: Bitcoin fell below $70,000 as crypto sentiment hit its lowest level in more than four months, with analysts warning of institutional outflows, thinning liquidity and elevated leverage.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Russian crude production rebounds after Trump diesel deal, IEA says as oil markets return to surplus
top_signals.summary: Russia’s crude output rose to 8.73 million barrels a day in October as recovering Gulf exports pushed global supply above demand, the IEA said.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Cramer says Jensen Huang betrayed Nvidia shareholders. How to pick up the pieces
top_signals.summary: Without Huang, Cramer said Thursday, "There won't be a better Nvidia, just a different one."
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
